final_claim: For H=c(I-ee^T), d>k≥1, Haar k-subspace and nonzero deterministic gradient g, the unregularized subspace solution exists a.s. Its step-norm tail exponent is (d-k)/2 for any e-component and d-k when g⊥e, giving finite qth moment iff q<r/2 or q<r. Explicit tail constants, finite-second-moment rational formula and ridge divergences are given.
